scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.official_source: New Zealand Government (Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme, administered by Education New Zealand | Manapou ki te Ao)

existing.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are offered by the New Zealand Government to eligible citizens of developing countries to study at a New Zealand or Pacific education institution. The tertiary strand is described by the administering agency as full scholarships for eligible international students to study full-time, and scholars may study at one of eight universities or three institutes of technology in New Zealand, or at one of two Pacific universities. The programme also runs vocational, thematic cohort and English language training for officials strands. Applications are submitted through the Manaaki applicant portal and require an academic transcript including the grading scale, with the awarding body warning that application systems may close early for countries with high application volumes.
eligibility: Citizenship of an eligible country or region (see the official eligible-countries list)
Must meet all of the official eligibility criteria
For tertiary study: a place to study full-time at a New Zealand university or institute of technology, or at a Pacific university for eligible Pacific citizens
existing.eligibility_summary: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are only available to citizens from eligible countries and regions, and applicants must meet all of the eligibility criteria. Tertiary scholars study full-time at one of eight universities or three institutes of technology in New Zealand, or at one of two Pacific universities for eligible Pacific citizens.
benefits: Full tertiary scholarship for full-time study at a New Zealand or Pacific education institution
Access to preferred-candidate priority for scholars who have already applied and been assessed
Manaaki Scholar Code of Conduct applies to all scholars
coverage: Full tertiary scholarship covering study at a New Zealand or Pacific education institution
The official pages read do not itemise the individual cost components, so no component-level claim is made here
requirements: Upload the academic transcript including the Grading Scale as part of the application
If shortlisted, supply verified English translations of transcripts and completion certificates
Select study preferences within the application portal
Agree to the Manaaki Scholar Code of Conduct
documents: Academic transcript for the qualification applied for, including the Grading Scale, uploaded with the application (explicitly not required for Samoa Foundation applicants)
If shortlisted, verified English-translated copies of academic transcripts and completion certificates
application_method: Online application through the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship applicant portal
Complete the eligibility questionnaire, then select study subjects and research available courses
existing.selection_notes: Selection follows the official steps: check eligible countries, check eligibility criteria, study subjects, research available courses, apply, then the selection process. Preferred candidates are first in line for a scholarship. How long selection takes depends on the number of applicants.
existing.best_fit: Students from developing countries including Bangladesh committed to home-country development
existing.duration: Duration of the eligible tertiary programme of study
existing.application_period: Annual round with country- and region-specific opening and closing dates published on the official site; the 2026 tertiary round has closed and the next round's dates are not yet published.
existing.deadline_display: The official site states: "Tertiary applications for the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme have now closed." The only dated window published on the pages read is the Samoa Foundation round: "Applications for Samoa Foundation open midnight 4 August 2026 and close midday 4 September 2026". The awarding body also warns that "the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme application system may close early to countries with a large volume of applications".
